messages:
Maris: prod alert — gs-12 hit an OOM from the KV layer while serving a long convo (ctx ~ 63k tokens). fallback to smaller model did not trigger :fire:

Alex: saw the same in logs. kv_pinned_bytes kept growing until oom. no eviction events in the window.

sre-bot: incident #INC-2026-887 posted: https://internal/inc/INC-2026-887 — paging spikes + OOM on runtime-1.

Kim: quick profiler dump (relevant lines):
```
kv_slot_pinned=4312
kv_pinned_bytes=1.9G
kv_slots_free=120
evict_cycles=0
alloc_headroom=128M -> rapidly falling
```
Seems like pinned allocations never eligible for eviction — pin_age drift.

Andrew: likely interaction between batching heuristics and kernel selection: large batches keep prefixes hot and prevent reuse window from closing. we need an emergency knob to drop pin_priority for long ctxs.

Sophia: mitigation proposal (short term):
- enable age-weighted eviction with immediate effect
- lower per-shard pin threshold from 256MB -> 64MB
- add a short throttle for any incoming request with ctx > 32k during rollout

Kim: config patch to flip (canary):
```
kv.eviction.enabled = true
kv.eviction.policy = "age_weighted"
kv.pin_threshold_bytes = 67108864  # 64MB
runtime.long_ctx_throttle.max_qps = 2
```

Maris: sounds good. plan: canary deploy to runtime-prod-canary (5%), monitor kv_pinned_bytes, evict_cycles, tail_latency for 30m, then 20% for 30m, then full. rollback if stall > 5 min or errors spike.

deploy-bot: started canary deploy: tag=kv-age-evict-2026-03, target=runtime-prod-canary, pct=5.

Alex: long term we should add a graceful-degrade path: on soft oom threshold, drop old KV turns (best-effort) and continue streaming partial completions instead of hard failing. also instrument kernel selection to prefer memory-friendlier kernels when pinned bytes > threshold.

Sophia: agree — add two items to backlog: "soft-oom streaming degrade" and "kernel mem-aware selector". I'll open JIRA and link to the incident.

Maris: created ticket INF-5023 with rollback playbook and sched for postmortem. I'll own rollout. tagging oncall @Kim for watches. :eyes:

Kim: watching. if we see any regression in p99 latency from kernel switch, we revert quick.

Andrew: also adding a metric kv_pin_fraction_per_prefix and an alarm at 0.8 so we catch this earlier.

Maris: thanks all. follow-up: postmortem and perf profile attached to INF-5023.
